body:
A independent source review of0f820dff found no blocking implementation defect; all runtime gates remain on A. Please add two source-only test gaps on your existing codex/save-destination-swift branch, preserving current work and no builds/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart:
1. DocumentSaveDestinationCommitTests forced fallback test currently forces ENOSYS only for successful link, then collision call omits hook. Add forced ENOSYS and EINVAL collision cases against existing sentinel, assert destinationExists, unchanged bytes/inode, own stage removed.
2. EngineDocumentBackendTests conflict currently uses a clean already-saved current path and missing-parent only asserts any throw. Add dirty document to a different existing target; assert original path/title/dirty markers remain, and missing-parent reports ordinary bridged DocumentError type.
Publish exact source/tests UNRUN handoff; A alone compiles and merges. Do not overlap Smart Preview work. Existing result0a6d71e8 is accepted on A, compiler lane currently testing Smart Preview CPU component. No repeat of original implementation requested.
